source_profile.locator: Liber III, second-house elections, chapter II, p.135: received money remaining long
source_profile.interpretation: For retaining received money, the cited passage requests fixed signs for the Ascendant, its lord, Moon, second lord and angles.

source_conflicts.scope: Borrowing/lending, not the implemented retention/circulation categories
source_conflicts.locator: chapter I p.135 versus chapter II Haly discussion
positions: Ramesey first rejects lending/borrowing under specified first-degree signs.
He then records Haly's distinction favoring borrower over lender in such cases.
source_conflicts.resolution: Recorded, not averaged or applied to an unrelated category.

unknown_criteria: Full radix and annual/world-revolution prerequisites not implemented.
Fortification is broader than the implemented sign/motion predicates; no claim of a complete Ramesey election.
Node afflictions, complete Moon perfection/prohibition and every event-specific exception remain unimplemented.

search_method.coverage: Partitions at computed sign ingresses, Ascendant/MC/second-cusp sign changes and stations; quarter-point checks flag unresolved cells.
search_method.limitation: Not a formal global completeness proof; unseen multiple reversals within a scan interval can be missed. Minimum-duration/user constraints can exclude short intervals.

limitations: No universal score, probability of success, or guarantee that these incomplete traditional criteria establish a favorable outcome.
No horary question-chart analysis; Technique #5 remains out of scope.
Exact lunar sequence is computed; source-complete historical prohibition, fortification and radix adjudication remain indeterminate.
